annotations.title: Put the month's bills into Xero as drafts

description: Put the month's bills into Xero as DRAFT bills, one per supplier, one line per job, with the original invoices attached. Without send: true it is a dry run that shows what would be sent. Running it again updates the same draft (no duplicates). A bill the trade has already approved is never changed; late invoices go on a top up bill. Never approves or pays.

send.description: true to really add the drafts. Default false (dry run).

name: push_bills_to_xero
